meta.title: Leo's Missing Homework
meta.textType: story: excuses and a school conversation

paragraphs: On Tuesday, December first, the class sat in the classroom at eight o'clock. Teacher Kim stood next to the blackboard. The words on it said, "Science: poster today." "Please put your water posters on your desks," she said. Lily, Mia, and May put their posters down and smiled at Teacher Kim. Leo stood up beside his desk, but his hands were empty. "Where is your poster, Leo?" asked Teacher Kim. Everybody looked at him, and the room was very quiet.

"I forgot it at Mia's house," said Leo. Mia shook her head. "You did not come to my house, Leo," she said. Leo turned his bag upside down. A ruler, an apple, and an eraser fell out, but there was no poster. "Perhaps my pen stopped working, so I could not finish it," he said. Then he added, "By the way, the blackboard has a funny spot." Lily looked at the blackboard, but she could not see a spot. Teacher Kim smiled a little. "That is three excuses, and all three are different," she said.

"Would you tell me the real reason, Leo?" asked Teacher Kim in a kind voice. Leo looked at his shoes for a moment. "I have a secret," he said. "I played a computer game until nine o'clock." "I was bored with the poster, and then I was too tired to work." Mia and Lily looked at each other, but nobody laughed. "Telling the truth is hard," said Teacher Kim, "but it is important."

"What a shame!" she said, and she smiled. "Thank you for the truth, Leo, and please bring the poster tomorrow." "I have not started it yet," said Leo. "I have already finished mine, so I can help you," said Lily. Mia held out her science textbook. "You can use it at home tonight," she said. "Thank you, Mia!" said Leo. He took the textbook with both hands.

At the end of the lesson, Lily took a piece of paper. She wrote a vocabulary list for the poster. She wrote four words: river, rain, cloud, and drop. Leo read the list and smiled. "I will not forget it again," he said. "Which word will you draw first?" asked Lily. "I will draw rain," said Leo, "and then a big blue river."
text.summary: Leo has no science poster to hand in, and he gives three excuses. Teacher Kim asks for the real reason, Leo tells the truth, and his friends help him.
